question: Among SME customers who paid in Czech koruna and had monthly consumption over 1000 in 2013, what was the average percentage increase in their total consumption from 2012 to 2013? Also, how many of these customers made transactions before 13:00 on any day in August 2012?

prediction.sql:
WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT c.XCL_001 AS cid
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth y ON c.XCL_001 = y.XCL_019
  WHERE c.XCL_002 = 'SME'
    AND c.XCL_003 = 'CZK'
    AND y.XCL_020 LIKE '2013%'
  GROUP BY c.XCL_001
  HAVING AVG(y.XCL_021) > 1000
),
consumption AS (
  SELECT y.XCL_019 AS cid,
         SUM(CASE WHEN y.XCL_020 LIKE '2012%' THEN y.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS total_2012,
         SUM(CASE WHEN y.XCL_020 LIKE '2013%' THEN y.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS total_2013
  FROM yearmonth y
  WHERE y.XCL_019 IN (SELECT cid FROM eligible)
    AND (y.XCL_020 LIKE '2012%' OR y.XCL_020 LIKE '2013%')
  GROUP BY y.XCL_019
),
early_aug AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.XCL_013 AS cid
  FROM transactions_1k t
  WHERE t.XCL_013 IN (SELECT cid FROM eligible)
    AND t.XCL_011 BETWEEN '2012-08-01' AND '2012-08-31'
    AND t.XCL_012 < '13:00:00'
)
SELECT AVG(CAST(c.total_2013 - c.total_2012 AS REAL) * 100 / c.total_2012) AS avg_pct_increase,
       COUNT(ea.cid) AS customers_before_13_aug_2012
FROM consumption c
LEFT JOIN early_aug ea ON c.cid = ea.cid
WHERE c.total_2012 > 0
